top_signals.title: Palantir CEO Alex Karp backs ousted Ukraine defense minister's new defense tech startup
top_signals.summary: Fedorov is launching a defense tech company backed by Palantir CEO Alex Karp, aiming to turn Ukraine’s wartime experience into new technologies.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
